items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1957-multiple
items.q: The interviewee discusses Willie Senior only in response to the interviewer's prompts, identifying him as a clarinet player and distinguishing him from family members (grandfather Jim Humphrey, father). No personal interaction or relationship is described by the interviewee.

ctx.x: Well, both of them play clarinet. I know, but the old man, he's daddy. The old man Jim was a trumpet player. Well, I mean, is he daddy? He's daddy. Well, that's where I got my learning from.

Willie Senior plays clarinet. Yeah. He's still alive. And the young boy. Young Willie, he's with Paul Barberin. Jim Humphrey was the name of the old grandfather. The trumpet player. Oh, what, his daddy? Yeah. We call him Mr. Willie.
